result.description: Cloud business phone system (calls, SMS, contacts, call analytics/AI) with a public REST API and webhooks.
result.auth_detail: Basic Auth with api_id (username) + api_token (password) generated by an Admin in the Aircall dashboard API Keys section. OAuth2 auth-code returns a permanent Bearer access_token scoped to one company; needs client_id/secret from Aircall, which requires Marketplace listing / Tech Partner program.
result.access_detail: API keys come from the dashboard of an existing Aircall company account (Admin only). No free developer sandbox found. OAuth client credentials are limited to partners listed on the Aircall App Marketplace (Tech Partner program). Some endpoints (Conversation/AI) are enabled per company.
result.api_notes: REST at https://api.aircall.io/v1. Resources: users, teams, calls, conversations, numbers, contacts, tags, messages, webhooks, companies, integrations, IVR, analytics, AI voice agents. Webhooks for call/user/contact/message events. 120 req/min per company.
result.blocker: No self-serve developer account: credentials need an existing Aircall customer account (API key) or Tech Partner/Marketplace approval (OAuth). No official MCP server.

evidence.quote: This service allows any developers to retrieve and manage Aircall data with HTTP requests.
With Aircall Public API, Authentication can be done through OAuth or Basic Auth.
The `api_id` is the _username_ and the `api_token` is the _password_ for each Public API requests.
It is a requirement to be listed on the Aircall App Marketplace.
If you haven't received them yet, apply to the Tech Partner program.
The root endpoint of Aircall Public API is `https://api.aircall.io/v1`.
This MCP server is NOT built, maintained, or endorsed by Aircall.
Unofficial MCP server for Aircall by Allo - 73 tools for calls, contacts, SMS, users, teams & AI insights.
